posts.content_md:
> **dannybee:** I have bee a bit skittish from going back into the lab because of my bouts with vertigo.. but know what caused it I can avoid it from happening again..have so many new ideas to try and so little time, may God stretch my time out and make it productive

Danny, I'd be happy to stretch your time and make it productive. But, my suggestion is that you could probably do it better yourself by venturing forth to the nearest pub, arming yourself with a beer, a pad and a pencil, and start sribbling at ideas between sips. This will accomplish both the time dilation and the productivity.
